rooms.14174: The walkway turns a corner here, where two lengths of the outer wall meet in a squat, roofless turret. A square hole in the turret floor drops down a ladder of iron rungs toward the hall along the inner wall. The wind comes over the battlements in hard, cold gusts, snatching at cloaks and breath alike. The broken walk runs on south along the wall top and west along the other face.
rooms.14175: Here a whole merlon has toppled inward and lies split across the walkway, so that you must clamber over its broken halves. Where it stood, nothing but a gap of empty air guards the drop to the scorched plain far below. Grit and flakes of mortar skitter along the stones with every gust. The walk goes on north toward the corner turret and south along the wall.
rooms.14176: A rusted iron brazier stands bolted to the parapet, its bowl full of old rainwater and a crust of black ash. The flagstones around it are scorched in a wide ring, as though the fire once spilled over. Beyond the battlements the dead land rolls away, grey and cracked, without a single tree. The walkway stretches north and south, its edges crumbling.
rooms.14177: A dark stain spreads across the flagstones here and runs down between the cracks, old enough to have dried brown, fresh enough to still smell of iron. Scrape marks lead to a gap in the parapet, as if something heavy was dragged to the edge and tipped over. The wind moans through that gap like a voice. The walkway continues north and south.
rooms.14178: The walkway grows narrower, hemmed in by iron stakes driven into the stone along both edges, their points flaking rust. A stone gargoyle crouches on the parapet, its face worn half away by wind and rain, its open mouth staring out over the wasteland. Ahead to the south the stakes crowd thicker, closing into a passage of spikes. The way back runs north along the open wall.
rooms.14180: Past the passage of spikes the walk opens a little, though the parapet here is little more than a stump of broken stone, knee-high and leaning outward. A banner pole juts from a socket in the wall, burned to a charred stick, a few blackened rags still knotted at its top. The wind tears at them without mercy. The walkway leads north back toward the spikes and south into deepening shadow.
rooms.22024: Darkness lies thick on this stretch of the wall, as if the stones themselves drink the light. You feel your way along the parapet with one hand, the stone cold and gritty, and more than once your fingers find nothing where a merlon should be. The wind howls unseen, and somewhere far below loose stones rattle as they fall. The walk gropes on north and south.
rooms.14182: The walkway meets a bend in the wall here, and a stair of worn steps spirals down through a broken hatch into the castle below. Iron hinges hang from the hatch frame, rusted through, the door itself long gone. The walk runs north along the wall, and west a narrow stretch disappears between high, close-set walls of dressed stone that look oddly smooth and new. Wind whistles down the stairwell like a breath drawn in.
rooms.22156: Close walls of dressed stone rise on either hand, and the moment you step between them a deep grinding begins somewhere inside the masonry. The walls are moving, sliding together on hidden runners with a sound like a millstone. Dust sifts from above as the gap shrinks to an arm's width, then less. There is no ledge to climb, no door, and no time left.
rooms.22180: Here the passage is barely wider than your shoulders, the stones on both sides scored with long scratches where someone tried to hold them apart. A low rumble shakes the floor, and the walls lurch inward a hand's breadth at a time. Old bones lie crushed flat in the cracks between the flagstones. Whatever way you turn, the stone is closing.
rooms.22162: Bloody handprints streak the smooth walls of this passage, smeared downward as if someone slid to the floor between them. With a shudder and a groan of chains deep in the castle, the two walls begin to grind toward each other. Splinters of old shields are pressed into the mortar where they failed to hold the stone back. The darkness fills with the roar of moving rock.
rooms.22030: A cold draught comes up through cracks in the walkway here, and in the dark you can hear the wind boring through the hollow wall beneath your feet. The parapet on one side has fallen entirely, leaving a lip of broken stone over a sheer drop. Somewhere ahead the grinding of great stones murmurs through the masonry. The walk leads east and west into blackness.
rooms.22031: Your boots crunch on a carpet of fallen slates, shed from some tower roof that once stood over this stretch and is now only a jagged stump. In the gloom the stump looms like a broken tooth against the faint glow of the wasteland's horizon. Rusted iron cramps that once bound the stones together jut from the wreckage at odd angles. The walkway runs on east and west.
rooms.22034: The walk sags here, the stones beneath it bowed by some old collapse inside the wall, so that every step tilts you toward the edge. A chain hangs from a bracket on the parapet and swings in the dark, its links clinking against the stone. Faintly, through the soles of your feet, you feel a rhythm of grinding from the way to the west. East the sagging walk climbs back toward firmer stone.
rooms.22163: The walkway funnels into a sealed passage of smooth stone, and a heavy slab drops behind you with a boom that shakes your teeth. At once the side walls shudder and begin to close, pushed by some engine buried deep in the castle. The air fills with stone dust and the shriek of grinding rock. There is nowhere left to stand.
rooms.14190: Pale grey daylight returns to the wall here, falling on a stretch of battlement scarred by fire. Every merlon is blackened, and an iron fire-basket hangs crooked from a hook, rusted into a shapeless lump. Both ways the walk vanishes between smooth, close walls: east into a passage that rumbles faintly, west into a hall where something heavy swings and whistles. Out past the parapet, the dead land stretches to a ruddy, smoking horizon.
rooms.14192: A corner of the outer wall, where a squat tower once rose and now stands only shoulder-high. Inside its broken ring a stair winds down into the castle, the steps choked with rubble. North the walkway runs on along the wall top, and east a narrow passage echoes with a slow, heavy swish of iron. The wind spins ash and grit around the ruined tower in tight circles.
rooms.22103: Shadow pools over this length of the walk, cast by a tall fragment of wall that leans out above it like a hand about to close. Beneath it the light is so poor that the edge of the walkway is only a guess. Water drips from the overhang and gathers in hollows worn into the flagstones. The walk goes north and south beneath the leaning stone.
rooms.14194: The parapet here is crowned with iron spikes set in lead, most of them snapped or bent outward by some long-ago assault. The broken hooks of a siege ladder are still caught on the stones, the wood long rotted away. To the north the walk narrows between smooth, close walls, and to the south it falls into deep shadow. The wind is so strong here that you lean into it just to stand.
rooms.22152: You step between two walls of polished stone that should not be here at all, and the floor drops a finger's breadth beneath your weight with a click. Deep in the castle something answers, and both walls begin to slide inward with a terrible grinding patience. Crushed armour and old bones are pressed flat into the joints. The passage shrinks around you.
rooms.14196: A wide breach yawns in the outer face of the wall, where a whole section of parapet has slumped away into the ditch far beneath. Only a ledge of cracked flagstones, scarcely two paces wide, carries the walk past it. Looking down makes your head swim: the drop goes on and on to a ruin of rubble at the wall's foot. The walkway carries on north, while south it slips between close, smooth walls.
rooms.14197: An old guard post stands here, a stone booth with no roof, its doorway facing into the wind. Inside, a bench is carved from the wall itself and a rusted lamp hook hangs empty. Names and tally marks are scratched across the inner stone, years of bored sentries keeping count of something. The walkway runs north and south past the booth.
rooms.14198: Two gargoyles flank the walk here, perched on the parapet back to back, one gazing out over the wasteland and one into the castle's inner courts. Rainwater has worn grooves down their stone flanks, and one has lost its head entirely. Between them the walkway is cracked straight across, a hand-wide fissure that whistles when the wind blows. North and south the wall top goes on.
rooms.14199: The walk climbs here over a hump in the wall where the masonry has heaved up, and the flagstones tilt like the deck of a ship in a swell. From the crest you can see the whole broken length of the outer wall curving away, its towers gutted and its battlements gap-toothed. Wind screams over the crest and drives grit into your eyes. The walkway goes north toward a corner and south down the slope.
rooms.14164: This is the corner where the outer walls meet at a great bastion, its top a broad platform of cracked stone. A hole torn in the middle of the platform opens onto a dark stair that leads down into the hall along the inner wall. Iron rings for siege engines are sunk in the flagstones, rusted fast. The walkway runs east along one wall and south along the other.
rooms.14165: The wall top is strewn with rubble here, chunks of masonry and broken coping stones fallen from a tower that has since collapsed. You pick a careful path between them, the wind tugging at you each time you step close to the edge. East the walk narrows between strangely smooth walls, and west it opens toward a broad corner bastion.
rooms.22150: A smooth-walled passage runs here where the open walkway should be, and its stone is warm, as if polished by long friction. The instant you are between the walls they begin to grind together, slow and certain. Dust pours from the seams overhead, and dark stains streak the stone at about the height of a man's chest. The roar of moving rock swallows every other sound.
rooms.14167: A flagstaff leans from the parapet at a drunken angle, the iron collar that held it cracked in two and its pole charred from top to bottom. Ashes of a banner cling in the joints of the stones, and a scorched crest is still just visible carved on the wall beneath. Past the parapet, rust-red cliffs and dead plains fall away into haze. The walk goes east and west, though westward it closes between smooth walls.
rooms.14168: The walkway is cracked into slabs here, each tilting a different way, so that you step from one to the next like stones in a stream. Between them the gaps show the hollow wall beneath, a dark shaft full of wind. Iron fittings bolted to the parapet weep long streaks of rust down the stone. The walk runs west, and east it narrows into a colder, stiller passage.
rooms.14170: A trough of stone runs along the inner side of the walkway here, meant once to carry boiling oil to the murder holes; it is cracked and stained black. The murder holes themselves gape in the parapet, square and empty, looking down on the castle gate far beneath. Wind pours through them with a low, hollow note. The wall top leads east and west, westward into a chill and narrowing passage.
rooms.14171: An entire section of battlements has been sheared away here, and for several paces the walkway runs with no parapet at all, open on the outer side to the long drop. The wind comes straight across the gap and threatens to shove you off. West the walk runs back toward the oil troughs, and east it enters a passage between smooth stone walls that look newer than everything around them.
rooms.14173: This stretch is littered with the shards of a shattered statue, a stone warrior whose plinth still stands on the parapet with only a pair of booted feet left upon it. The wind has scoured the broken pieces smooth and pale. East the walkway leads to a turret at the corner of the wall, while west it disappears between close, smooth walls of dressed stone.

216000.description: A broad hallway of old brick opens out of the sewer here, its floor raised above the foul water by a ramp of packed rubble. Someone has hung lanterns on iron hooks along the walls, though only a couple of candle stubs gutter in them. North the passage slopes down into the watery bend of the sewer, and south a heavy wooden door, patched with tin, closes off the way deeper in. The air stinks of damp and smoke.

216001.description: Candle stubs stuck to the bricks in puddles of their own wax give this corridor its only light, a weak yellow glow that barely reaches the arched ceiling. Water seeps down the walls and gathers in a gutter along the floor. A stout door in the east wall leads to a large room, the big hallway lies north, and to the south the corridor meets a crossing.

rooms.216002: This large chamber was once a cistern, and its vaulted brick ceiling is black with the soot of many fires. Crates and barrels have been stacked along the walls as makeshift tables and seats, and a ragged rug covers the worst of the damp floor. A sour smell of spilt ale and wet wool hangs over everything. The only way out is the door to the west.

216004.description: Four brick passages meet here beneath a low dome, and a drain grate in the centre gurgles with dark water running somewhere below. Chalk marks scrawled on the walls point the way: north toward the hallway, east and south along dim corridors, and west toward the barracks. A single lantern hangs from a chain overhead, its glass cracked and smoky.

216005.description: The corridor runs on in near-darkness, its bricks furred with grey mould and its floor slick underfoot. A door to the east is marked with a crudely painted bed, its planks worn pale around the latch. The passage widens to the south, while the crossroad lies back to the west. Droppings and mouldy straw gather in the corners where the candlelight never reaches.

rooms.216006: Rows of rough cots crowd this low brick room so tightly that there is hardly space to walk between them. The blankets are grey with damp, and straw pallets on the floor fill the gaps. Pegs hammered into the mortar hold nothing but cobwebs, and the room smells of sweat and mildew. A single low door leads west, back to the corridor.

216010.description: Here the passage broadens into a wide corridor, its brick arches shored up with timber props cut from old ship's beams. Warm smells of cooking drift from a dining room to the east, while a storeroom opens to the west. The corridor runs on south to a fork and back north into dimmer passages. The floor here has been swept, after a fashion.

rooms.216020: A long trestle table fills this chamber, built of planks laid across barrels and scarred with knife cuts and burns. Mismatched stools and upturned crates serve as seats, and the brick walls are slick with old grease. A door to the east lets out a smell of boiling cabbage and smoke from the kitchen. The wide corridor lies to the west.
rooms.216021: A sooty hearth has been knocked into the old brickwork here, its smoke drawn off up a crooked flue toward the streets above. Iron pots hang from hooks over the ashes, and a chopping block stands in the middle of the room, hacked deep by years of cleaver strokes. A barrel of murky water sits beside the hearth. The door to the dining room is to the west.

216013.description: The corridor splits here beneath a sagging brick arch. To the east a curtained doorway leads into Remo's office, and to the south the passage drops toward a chamber from which a smell of old blood and rust creeps out. The wide corridor lies to the north. Someone has scratched a warning into the bricks: a crude skull above crossed knives.

rooms.216014: This cramped office is the most comfortable corner of the hideout, with a threadbare carpet, a writing desk rescued from some burgled house, and a stuffed chair leaking horsehair. A map of the sewers has been painted on the bricks behind the desk, its tunnels marked with tiny daggers and coin signs. Candle soot stains the low ceiling in a black smudge. The way out is to the west.

216015.description: Iron rings, chains and hooks are bolted into the dripping brick of this chamber, and a heavy rack stands against one wall, its rollers stained dark. A brazier of dead coals sits beside a bench of rusted tools. In the floor a trapdoor with an iron grille opens on a ladder leading down to the prison. The three-way corridor is north, and the air is thick with the smell of old fear.

216016.description: A pit-like cell lies at the bottom of the ladder, walled in old brick and floored with filthy straw over standing water. Manacles hang from chains along the walls at different heights, some low enough for a child. The only light falls through the grille above, where the ladder climbs back up to the torture chamber. Scratches cover the bricks, counting days that nobody finished counting.

rooms.216023: Shelves of rough planks line this storeroom from floor to ceiling, mostly bare now except for empty crates and torn sacks. The words Rabdu Rana are burned into a board over the doorway, though what they mean is anyone's guess. A smell of spice and damp sacking lingers in the still air. The wide corridor is back to the east.

216009.description: Dripping water patters steadily in this stretch of corridor, falling from a cracked pipe that runs along the ceiling. Most of the candle stubs here have drowned in their niches. A door to the west lets out wisps of steam and a smell of lye soap, while a sturdier door to the south is fitted with a lock. The crossroad lies north.

rooms.216012: A round table stands in the middle of this room, cut from a single great slab of slate laid across stone blocks, with a ring of chairs drawn up around it. A charcoal sketch of streets and houses covers one brick wall, scrawled with arrows and marks: plans for jobs in the city above. Doors lead north to the corridor and west into a private office.
rooms.216011: Brandon's office is neater than anything else in the sewers, with planks laid over the floor to keep off the damp and a tall cabinet with a locked front. A heavy desk bears the scars of a dagger driven into it again and again. A small iron grate high in the wall lets in a breath of fresher air from the street above. The door east returns to the conference room.
rooms.216008: Water spills from a broken pipe overhead into this tiled chamber, a crude shower rigged by the gang from the city's own rain drains. The tiles are cracked and green with slime, and the floor slopes to a grating that gurgles without pause. Wooden pegs line the walls for clothes. Doors lead east to the corridor and west into the training room.
rooms.216007: Straw-stuffed dummies hang from beams across this wide brick room, slashed and stabbed until their stuffing spills out. Targets painted on the walls are pocked with knife holes, and a ring has been chalked on the floor for wrestling. Sawdust soaks up some of the damp underfoot. The door east leads to the shower room.

216003.description: This corridor leads toward the barracks, its brick walls hung with tattered blankets to keep out the draught. A door to the west opens on a sleeping room, and the corridor continues north toward more barracks. The crossroad lies back to the east, its lantern glow just reaching this far. The floor is worn into a groove by many feet.

216017.description: The barracks corridor ends here against a wall of newer brick, laid crudely to seal off an older tunnel beyond. Water has found its way through the mortar regardless and stains the bricks in long dark tongues. A door to the west leads into another room full of beds, and the corridor runs back south.

rooms.216018: Bunks built of salvaged timber are stacked three high in this narrow room, so close to the arched ceiling that the top sleepers must lie flat. Each bunk has a rag curtain, and initials are carved deep into the posts. The air is close and warm and smells of tallow. The door east leads back to the corridor.
rooms.216019: Hammocks are slung between iron hooks driven into the brickwork here, crossing the room at every height like a fisherman's nets hung to dry. A brazier in the corner keeps off a little of the chill, its smoke escaping through a crack in the vault. The floor is littered with straw and gnawed bones. The only door leads east to the barracks corridor.

7329.description: Fire has gutted this chamber, blistering the brick walls and melting the iron fittings into dripping, twisted shapes. The floor is ankle-deep in ash, still faintly warm, and the air tastes of smoke. A scorched archway to the south opens into the red dragon's lair, glowing dully, while to the west a tunnel draws a breath of cool, moving air.

7327.description: This room bends sharply in the shape of an L, its long arm running toward a crossing of hallways to the north and its short arm opening east into the dragon's lair. The bricks along the short arm are scorched and cracked by heat. Ash and soot drift across the floor, and the air is uncomfortably warm. Strange clawed prints mark the dust.

7320.description: This is the far corner of the lair, where the great square chamber narrows to a dead end of soot-blackened stone. Huge gouges score the walls at the height of a tall man, as if something enormous has sharpened its claws here. The lair opens out again to the north and to the east. A heap of cracked bones and charred rubble fills the corner.

rooms.404: A broad pit of black tar fills most of this chamber, bubbling sluggishly and giving off a choking, oily reek. A narrow rim of stone runs around it, slick with spatters, and fighters who lose their footing sink to the knees in the hot pitch. From the galleries overhead comes the stamping of the crowd. The ramp lies east, the arena centre south, and the gauntlet west.
rooms.415: A high stone arch spans this chamber like a bridge, and the fight takes place on its curved crown, with nothing to either side but a fall to the flooded floor below. A rope ladder dangles from the arch down into the stepladder pit. The crowd leans over the gallery rail, howling for someone to slip. West the arch runs into a blaze of light.
rooms.416: Great polished bronze mirrors line the walls of this chamber, catching the light of a hundred lamps and hurling it into the centre in a single blinding glare. The sand underfoot is hot as a summer beach, and fighters squint and stumble half-blind. A trapdoor in the floor opens onto a ladder down to the spikewall. The arc lies east.
rooms.417: One whole wall of this chamber bristles with iron spikes, some longer than a sword, their points dark and crusted. The floor slopes gently toward them, so that every shove and stumble drives a fighter closer. A ladder climbs through the ceiling to the sunblaze, and an archway north leads back to the arena centre. The crowd above roars each time someone is pinned.
rooms.410: A narrow catwalk of planks and iron runs high across this chamber, hung on chains from the vault and swaying with every step. Far beneath, the floor is a bed of broken stone. Spectators in the gallery hurl jeers at fighters as they inch along. East the catwalk reaches the scaffold over the lava, and south it drops toward the slide.
rooms.418: A long, narrow run of the arena is lined on both sides by alcoves from which blades on iron arms swing out at anyone passing. The floor is scored with old grooves, and the walls are spattered brown. From slots high above, the crowd watches and wagers. East lies the tar pit, and west the flicker of the fire circle.
rooms.419: A ring of iron troughs filled with burning oil encircles the sand of this round chamber, and the flames leap waist-high, hemming fighters in. The heat is staggering and the smoke stings your eyes. Banners of past champions hang above, scorched along their edges. A gap in the ring opens east toward the gauntlet, and north a short passage leads into a cramped dead end.
rooms.420: This chamber was built to trap: whoever is driven in here must fight or fall, with nowhere to run. The walls are high and sheer, polished so smooth that no hand can grip them. Sand lies thick and churned, dark in places with old blood. South a single archway leads back to the arena centre.
rooms.408: A deep trench has been dug across this chamber and left as raw dirt, its sides crumbling, its floor a churned mess of mud and gravel. Fighters must leap or scramble across, and the footing gives way without warning. The crowd's shouts echo down from the galleries. The arena centre lies east, and a low hole to the south opens into a crawlspace.
rooms.25006: The ceiling drops so low here that you must crawl on hands and knees through packed earth between old timber props. The roar of the crowd comes muffled through the stone, like surf heard from far away. Damp seeps from the walls, and a sloping hole in the floor drops down toward the mud basin. The dirt ditch is back to the north.
rooms.413: You are swimming in a basin of thick brown water, warm and sluggish, that clings to your limbs like porridge. Bubbles rise from the mud beneath and burst with a stink of rot. A sloped hole in the ceiling leads up into the crawlspace, and a low ledge to the east climbs out into a hidden alcove. No gallery overlooks this place; the crowd is only a distant rumble.
rooms.414: A small dry alcove lies hidden off the mud basin, well out of sight of the galleries. Someone has scratched tallies and names into the rock, and a ledge forms a rough bench where a wounded fighter could rest. The noise of the arena is faint here, almost peaceful. The only way out is back west into the mud.

6501.description: The path runs straight into the mountainside here, where a tunnel mouth has been cut square and true through the living rock by dwarven hands. Runes of welcome are carved into the stone lintel, and iron brackets for torches line the rock walls. Ahead to the north the tunnel climbs on into darkness, while behind you daylight and the open path fall away to the south.

rooms.6531: The throne of Rock-Haven stands on a dais of polished granite, its back carved into a mountain peak inlaid with veins of silver. Pillars hewn from the rock rise to a vaulted ceiling, and braziers burn on either side of the throne, glinting off the shields of old dwarf-kings hung on the walls. A carved door to the north leads to the master chambers, and the top of the stairs is west.
rooms.206533: This is a snug sleeping chamber cut from warm red stone, with a broad bed of carved oak piled with furs and wool blankets. A small hearth set into the wall glows low, and the smell of woodsmoke and pipeweed lingers. Neatly mortared niches hold a few candle stubs. The only door leads west back to the master chambers.
rooms.206527: Unlike the stone halls around it, this room is panelled from floor to ceiling in dark wood, the boards fitted so tightly no seam shows. Dust lies thick across the floor, unmarked by any footprints, and cobwebs hang in the corners. A stale smell of old timber and closed air fills the room. The only way out is south into another wooden room.
rooms.80304: You cling to the steep face of the great pyramid, where the plaster has cracked away to show huge blocks of yellow stone beneath. The sun beats down without mercy, and the stones are hot enough to blister bare hands. Below, the desert spreads out in waves of gold to the edge of sight. The climb goes on east along a ledge, or south back down the slope.
rooms.80305: A narrow ledge runs across the face of the pyramid here, scarcely wide enough for your boots, and the wind hurls stinging sand against your back. The apex is close now, just a short scramble up over the last few courses of stone. The glare off the white plaster is blinding. West the ledge leads back along the face.
rooms.1201: Two deep armchairs sit before a crackling hearth in this cosy room, a patchwork rug between them and a kettle singing on its hook over the fire. Shelves crammed with curious keepsakes from every corner of the realm cover the walls: a ship in a bottle, a jar of captured starlight, a cracked mortal crown. A door to the north opens, quite impossibly, onto the shore of the Long Lake, and another to the east leads to the Immortal Room of Relaxation. Time seems to pass here at whatever pace it likes.
rooms.6398: High in the branches of a vast, grey-barked tree, a platform of tangled limbs forms a rough floor, thick with old webbing that sticks to your boots. Silk ropes as thick as your arm run off between the trunks, and a webbed walkway leads north toward a dark entrance shrouded in spun threads. Far below, a narrow forest path winds through the gloom, reachable by climbing down. The leaves hang still and the air smells of rot.
rooms.15301: A white marble altar stands at the heart of this quiet chapel, draped with a cloth embroidered in gold and lit by tall candles in silver holders. Stained glass throws soft colours over the polished floor, and the hush is deep enough that your footsteps seem loud. Behind the altar, a narrow stair hidden in the floor leads down into darkness. An archway east opens toward the foot of the castle tower.

14178.description: The gargoyle has the body of a hunched hound and the wings of a bat, but wind and rain have worn its face to a blunt, eyeless knob. Its jaws still gape wide, and rust from the iron pin that holds it has stained its chest red.

14197.description: Dozens of names are scratched into the stone, most of them worn faint, each followed by rows of tally marks in groups of five. The newest marks stop halfway through a group.

14173.description: Only the statue's booted feet remain on the plinth, broken off at the ankle. Letters were once cut into the plinth's face, but they have been chiselled out deliberately, leaving a rough scar.

216014.description: The painted map shows the sewer tunnels beneath Garathorm in careful lines of black and red. Little daggers mark the gang's hiding places, and coin signs mark the houses above that have already been robbed.

216023.description: The words are burned deep into a plank of old ship's timber, the letters uneven, as if done with a hot poker by someone who could barely write.

416.description: Each mirror is taller than a man, its bronze polished to a fierce shine and tilted on a pivot so that the arena keepers can turn the glare wherever they please. Their frames are dented where fighters have tried to smash them.

419.description: The banners bear the names and colours of champions who won the Bedlam Arena, stitched in gold thread. The oldest have faded nearly white, and the flames have eaten the hems of all of them.

6531.description: The throne is carved from a single block of dark granite, its high back shaped into a mountain whose peak is capped with a band of silver. Runes around its base name the kings who have sat upon it.

15301.description: The altar is carved from one block of white marble, veined with faint gold. Its face shows a sunburst above the crowned arms of King Welmar, worn smooth at the edges by generations of kneeling hands.
